title: Persona
description: Coherent device persona. All fields MUST be verified against a real device capture (gl_renderer_verified=true before production use).

gpu_family.comment: MUST match the real GPU of the device the app runs on (validated at runtime against Build/GL_RENDERER)

gpu.comment: Exact GL_RENDERER string as reported by a REAL device, e.g. 'Mali-G52 2EEMC2'

gl_renderer_verified.comment: false = placeholder, must not be used until captured from real hardware

android_version.comment: MUST be <= device's real Android version

build_fingerprint.comment: ro.build.fingerprint format: brand/product/device/version/...; copy from a real device of this model

mutable_surface.description: Fields the profile system may vary per profile within this device's realistic range

timezone.comment: Must stay coherent with proxy exit IP geolocation
